laws_and_bills.name: SB 439 (2026) limiting local regulation of data centers
laws_and_bills.what: Would have limited local regulation of data centers; tabled May 2026.

laws_and_bills.name: Gov. Ayotte's proposed statewide data center moratorium
laws_and_bills.what: Ayotte (2026-09-03) said she will put a multi-year moratorium in her next budget (effective July 2027 at the earliest); an executive order could act sooner. House Democrats plan a 24-month moratorium bill for the 2027 session.

local_rules.what: Residents voted in March 2026 to ban AI companies from siting data centers.

dockets.what: Preliminary study agreement between Eversource and Granite Shore Power on the viability of connecting a 350 MW project at the Merrimack Station site in Bow. No NH PUC docket on data centers or large loads found.

incentives.name: None: no data-center-specific state tax incentive found
incentives.what: New Hampshire has no data center tax incentive in NCSL's 'Status of Data Center Tax Incentives, by State (2026)' table (adapted from Husch Blackwell's 50-state survey, last updated 2026-07-27; listed as N/A; table data: https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/TQYDf/5/dataset.csv). New Hampshire has no general sales tax. NCSL (2026-04-09) says a New Hampshire bill to create new data center incentives was defeated in committee (bill number not captured).
